    // The area-weighted quadric of one triangle: the quadric of the plane it lies
    // in, scaled by its area. Area weighting is the standard practical refinement
    // of the paper's unweighted sum — without it a fan of slivers outvotes the
    // large faces around it.
    TriangleQuadric(t: Triangle3D): Quadric
        => Quadric(PlaneQuadric(t.FromTriangle).Coefficients * t.Area);
